title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: The graph shows the distribution of the number of children in the families of the students in Ms. Jordan’s English class. The median number of children in the family for this distribution is

solutions.text:
The graph gives \(2\) families with \(1\) child, \(1\) with \(2,\) \(2\) with \(3,\) \(2\) with \(4,\) and \(6\) with \(5,\) for \(2 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 6 = 13\) families.

The median is the \(7\)th value in order. Listing the family sizes, the \(7\)th value is \(4.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The median is the middle value when all the family sizes are listed in order
Count the total number of families, then find which position is the middle one
